style_prefix: 2D pixel art character portrait for a moody night-shift tactics game, hand-placed pixels on a strict grid, crisp hard edges with zero anti-aliasing, chunky readable forms, limited palette with dithering instead of gradients, bust-up framing, facing the viewer.
style_suffix: Palette is locked to the game's own colors: night ground #0d0e14 and #181b26, ally teal #5fb7c4, phantom crimson #c8455f, brass #d9a441, skin #f7d7b4 with #d99a72 shadow. Keep the silhouette readable at 64px. Match the flat, slightly desaturated look of a late-90s handheld RPG portrait.
